setup: The expression is the [[root]] root of \([[radicand]]\).

steps.say: \([[radicand]]\) is a perfect [[root]], which is why its [[root]] root is a whole number.
The [[root]] root asks which number, raised to that power, gives the radicand.
Raising \([[answer]]\) to that power returns \([[radicand]]\), so the root is exact.
